_note: Models the guard pools that are NOT auto-discovered from OpenRouter's free list (free_models.json). 'slug' MUST equal the router's to_slug() output (provider/model) so availability lines up. kind: 'interface' = called via a bespoke adapter (Codex CLI, claude -p); 'api-free' = a normal free API tier the router calls via LiteLLM. Buckets/limits come from free_limits.json by glob match (google-gemini/* etc.); an entry with no matching rule is treated as always-available (soft; live-429 rotation is the backstop).

models.notes: GPT via Codex CLI endpoint; ~10 calls / 5h window (known_limits openai/gpt-free).
Claude Opus via `claude -p --model opus` (JP's flat subscription). No request rule -> always-available; live-429 rotation is the backstop if a usage window is hit.
Claude Sonnet via `claude -p --model sonnet` (flat subscription). Leads the stredni tier.
Claude Haiku via `claude -p --model haiku` (flat subscription, cheap/fast). Backup on trivialni/stredni.
Claude Fable (claude-fable-5) via `claude -p --model fable`. Creative model — not in difficulty tiers; pooled available for future direct-pick in OWUI.
Router workhorse (free alias — versioned 3.x-flash are paid-only on Arch key). Shared with Hermes chat; matches google-gemini/* rule bucket.
Router light tier (free alias). Shared with Hermes fallback; matches google-gemini/* rule bucket.
